official_migration_evidence.b3_quotes_page: Since 2025-12-15, listed tick-by-tick data is available in BDM under Derivativos > Derivativos de bolsa > Negócio a negócio.
official_migration_evidence.external_communication: CE 001/2026-VTEC states all former public-data-page information was migrated to the Boletim Diario do Mercado and the old page was discontinued on 2026-03-31.

frozen_qualification_questions.schema_identity: Require stable trade schema containing exact WIN instrument identity and trade timestamp fields.
frozen_qualification_questions.timezone_session_semantics: Prove the interpretation and timezone/session mapping of HoraFechamento and DataNegocio without inferring from economics or reconstructing missing clocks.
frozen_qualification_questions.publication_semantics: Prove when a session becomes publicly observable and whether the file is intraday, end-of-day, D+1, or later.
frozen_qualification_questions.revision_semantics: Prove whether published rows/files may be revised, cancelled, replaced, or adjusted and how revisions are identified.
frozen_qualification_questions.pit_validity: Qualification must support point-in-time use without hindsight or silent replacement.
frozen_qualification_questions.coverage: Require at least 161 distinct eligible B3 trading sessions in the frozen evaluation corpus; transport availability alone does not grant credit.
frozen_qualification_questions.independence: Evaluation data must remain independent and unseen by family selection; no economics may be read during source qualification.
